name: Trabada (Spain)
description: Eight wavy horizontal stripes of white and blue with a green triangle with its base along the hoist charged with a yellow castle.
history: The arms and flag of Trabada were approved by decree on 10 July 1992, published in the Diario Oficial de Galicia on 27 July 1992; the flag is rectangular, its length one and a half times its width, wavy-barry of eight stripes, half white and half blue, with a green triangle at the hoist.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
